content: Yoniꞌa ani faleno neꞌapateya vekamoꞌa aeno hakalo huno hapa paiꞌniya gemae
Ani afinaꞌmo ani faleno neꞌapateya vekamo Yoniꞌa eno Yutiya kotegamo kaꞌme koteꞌmo maiꞌneno aepa faino aeno hakalo huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaino apatesiya afinaꞌmo alagi ago hogo huꞌniyanagi lapaipamo alitapa afe leyo, huno hapa paino maiꞌniye.
Aiyeyaꞌa Gotitegati gemo alinineno aeno hakalo huno hapa nepaiya vekamoꞌa Yonifeꞌmo ava gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo,

content.text: Mago vekamo eno kaꞌme kotega maiꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo, Ala kava neꞌmo esiya kaꞌmo valitapa ateyo. Esiya kaꞌmo api kaꞌmo valitapa ateyo, huno keya aeno ge nehiye,

content: huno avoꞌmo kae maleꞌniye.
Yoniꞌa kukenaꞌamo kamolu afumo ayokatetiꞌmo alo huꞌnaya kukenamo vaiteno kamolu agufaletiꞌmo alo huꞌnaya mapalumo afafaleꞌmo aeteno akenuꞌe kevekeve anuꞌeꞌmo neno maiꞌniye.
Asole vayaꞌmo alopa taonimo Yulusalemu taonifatiꞌmo agaetegamo ege muki Yutiya kotegatiꞌmo aluga aluga haopalegatiꞌmo ege Yoneni aniꞌmo nelamiya haopalegatiꞌmo ege huꞌa eꞌnae.
Apakaemo eꞌa hosu kavaꞌapieꞌmo aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa ha paiꞌnageno Yoneni anipiꞌmo ani faleno apateꞌniye.

Asole Falasi mono vayanagi Satiyusi mono vayanagi huꞌa ani faleno apatesiyafeꞌmo agaetegamo eꞌnageno apaketenoꞌaeꞌmo, Nagaloꞌyave vayaꞌmogitapae, huno, Gotiꞌa aipamo leno lapatesiya afinaꞌmo ago afole aigefe nehiyanagi ina laꞌmo, afaꞌa faitapa kasalo paegae, huno lapa paiꞌniye.
Lapaipamo alitapa afe leꞌnisayana saufa kavaꞌmo hutetapa alita nave liyo.
Lapakaemo, Emalehamuꞌa lagaiti laginago netimo maiꞌniye, hutapa lapakesa oꞌafiyo. Gotiꞌa mani yafapatiꞌmo Emalehamu aginagoꞌamo afaꞌa alino hamaleno apategaiye.
Koꞌneletiꞌmo yosamo hafuꞌyaꞌaꞌeꞌmo heno halagatino atalesiyafeꞌmo ago alo huno maleꞌniye. Agaemo muki yosamoꞌmo alagepa alagamo noꞌaesiyana koꞌneletiꞌmo heꞌya aino atafiꞌmo kaegaiye.

Nagaemo lapaipamo alitapa afe leꞌnaya kavatefeꞌmo aniꞌaletikeꞌmo faleꞌna nelapatovanageno nagae nakame huno esiya vekamoꞌmo Goti Aote Aunemeꞌaletiꞌe ataletiꞌeꞌmo ani faleno lapategaiye. Agae lokiyaꞌamoꞌmo nagae lokiyaꞌnimo ago aeno naga seꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo afa neꞌmo maiꞌneꞌna aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaluva vekaꞌagana huꞌna maiꞌnovanageꞌna suꞌaletiꞌmo nofiꞌamo afaꞌa hakalu osegauve.

Agaemo sipetiꞌamo ayapiꞌmo aliꞌniyanageno vitimo haletiꞌyaꞌamo sipetiletiꞌmo haleteno neꞌyaꞌamo alino noꞌafiꞌmo anupa huno maleteno haletiꞌyaꞌamo alino yu oseno neleya atafiꞌmo kaegaiye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yoniꞌa Yesuꞌmo ani faleno ateꞌniya gemae
Ani afinaꞌmo Yesuꞌa Galeliya kotegatiꞌmo Yoniꞌa ani faleno atesiyafeꞌmo Yoneni anitegamo eꞌniye.
Eꞌniyaꞌmonanafa Yoniꞌa ge huno atafauno atesiyafeꞌmo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, Kagaekeꞌmo ani faleka nateganaꞌmonanafa kagaemo nagaetegamo eꞌnane, huno ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo

Yesuꞌa, he, ani kavaꞌmo haneꞌniyaꞌmonanafa hemenimo kagaemo geꞌnimo afa akame hugetaꞌao. Ani kava hisuꞌana muki Goti geꞌamo akame hutetaꞌa fatago kavaꞌamo alitaꞌa he titaꞌa ategauꞌae, huno ha paiꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo Yoniꞌa, he kanalene, huno huꞌniye.
Yoniꞌa Yesuꞌmo ani faleno atetegenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa anipatiꞌmo haineneꞌegenoꞌaeꞌmo kokuꞌnaꞌmo aino akaka vaeꞌnigeno ageyana Goti Aunemeꞌamo kaugoꞌyave namagana huno agaeteꞌmo emineꞌnigeno ageꞌniye.
Kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo mago gemo hunoꞌaeꞌmo, ani vekaeꞌmo nagaiꞌni nahau nayamopafiꞌmo nahauꞌniya mafaꞌneꞌnimo maiꞌniye. Agaefeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌna amuse huꞌna neꞌatove, huno huꞌniye.
